formulas.formula: Know where your food money goes, spend less each week, and never forget the milk.
1. Setup: type the year, how many people you feed, and your monthly grocery budget. Adjust the categories and their monthly targets, and list the stores you use.
2. Spending: after each shop, log what you spent by category (one line per category, or one line for the whole trip).
3. Monthly: change any month's budget (holidays, guests) in the Budget column. Blank = your normal budget.
4. Dashboard: this month at a glance, week by week. Pick the month on Setup.
5. Shopping List: plan your next trip and see if it fits what's left this month.
6. Price Book: compare prices across your stores so you know where each item is cheapest.
7. Meal Plan: plan two weeks of meals, then build your list from it.
Lines with the same date and store count as one trip, so you can split a receipt by category.
Type coupon, sale and cashback savings in the Saved column to see what your deal-hunting is worth.
Spending divided by the people in your household. Handy for comparing months.
Week 1 is days 1 to 7, week 2 is days 8 to 14, and so on. Each week's budget is its share of the month.
Clear the white cells on Spending, Shopping List, Price Book and Meal Plan, then update Setup.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you.
Green: within budget, or the best price.
Red: over budget, or something to check.
Thank you for your purchase! Happy shopping.
